posts.name: evandan457
posts.cooked:
I’m too desensitized from hours upon hours of Mortal Kombat to really care whose heart gets ripped out. Plus, I’d love to see the Sentinels do some fatalities of their own.

And most fighting games are like that though. You’ve got people who have incredible abilities that could destroy the other player in one hit IRL, but the other character being just fine after receiving the attack that just snapped their spine or both their eyes being blinded. That’s what makes a fighting game work. The only fighting game that really tried to keep an element of realism (a spear to the face being an instant kill, etc.) was the Deadliest Warrior game, and that just sucked.
